name: Scioto County, Ohio (United States)
description: Burgee shaped like the Ohio flag, with fly-pointed triangles of blue and yellow on white, blue towards the hoist, charged with the county seal.
history: Scioto County is a county on the Ohio River in south-central Ohio. Flags of the World records that this burgee replaced a previous 1986 flag designed by Amy Brown.

features.role: yellow triangle pointing to the fly
county seal in yellow and brown reading OFFICIAL SEAL SCIOTO COUNTY, OHIO 1803
